assignments.name: Set_Category
assignments.label: Set Transaction Category
assignments.description: Assigns the derived FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c back onto the in-flight GT. Before-save flows edit $Record in place with no DML — free and safe.

Flow.description: Fundraising Quick Start: on insert of an Expected GiftTransaction that has a parent Gift Commitment but no explicit FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c, stamps the category from the parent commitment's FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c. Covers engine-fanned Expected GTs from Regular Scheduled and Recurring commitments (the launcher never touches them directly). Mapping: Pledged Gift → Pledge Payment; Recurring Gift → Recurring Gift Payment; Grant Payout → Grant Payment. Fires only when the field is blank so manual entries (Simple Pledge's Expected GT, Custom's explicit stamping) are never overwritten.

formulas.name: Derived_Category
formulas.expression: CASE( TEXT({!Get_Commitment.FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c}), "Pledged Gift", "Pledge Payment", "Recurring Gift", "Recurring Gift Payment", "Grant Payout", "Grant Payment", "" )

Flow.label: FQS Auto Category Gift Transaction

recordLookups.name: Get_Commitment
recordLookups.label: Get Parent Commitment
recordLookups.description: Fetches the parent Gift Commitment to read its FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c. Only queried fields are Id + the category picklist — cheap lookup.
